name: persistence-shutdown-single-flight
description: Verify one unpublished-Studio lifecycle cycle reaches a ready ephemeral profile, stops into Edit mode, and emits no false or real persistence shutdown failure warning.

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local Players=game:GetService('Players')
local deadline=os.clock()+20
local player=Players:GetPlayers()[1]
repeat
 task.wait(.05)
 player=Players:GetPlayers()[1]
until os.clock()>=deadline or (player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true)
local root=workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG')
local mode=root and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode') or ''
local ready=player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true
local writable=player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==true
local state=player and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState') or ''
local ok=mode=='EphemeralStudio' and ready and not writable and state=='EphemeralStudio'
return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,mode=mode,ready=ready,writable=writable,state=state})

steps.label: wait boundedly for the ready non-writable ephemeral profile
stop play and run the shutdown lifecycle
allow Studio output to flush after the Edit transition
post-stop console has no runtime errors
